name: Tile-based Volume Ray Marching
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores 3D volume data in a 1D texture array organized into tiles, using ray marching to sample the volume and composite the result using front-to-back accumulation.
summary: Tile-based Volume Ray Marching is a GPU-accelerated technique that decomposes volumes into 2D tiles for cache-friendly access, distinguishing itself by using fixed uniform tiling and hardware filtering instead of complex metadata or software caching.
